verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for a business banking platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a public API. Every documented workflow (account details, card freezing, limits, invoices, approvals) is described as done in the app UI. The accounting-software sync, the Plaid connectivity and the llms.txt file are integrations or adjacent features, not a programmatic API that matches the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
